name: Contracted-vs-catalog source switch mid-quote (IsContracted toggled / asset detach)
what_it_tests: When a line's IsContracted/ItemPricingSource changes between reprices (e.g. asset detached so a contracted line reverts to catalog, or a fresh line becomes contracted), the procedure must re-route between Contacted Pricing and the catalog waterfall and clear the stale PricingDate; verifies the source-switch transition, not just steady-state A-02/A-04
proc_mechanism: Contacted Pricing (IsContracted=true AND PricingDate IsNull) vs catalog DP2 List Price; on switch to catalog the negative IsContracted branch + PricingDate must reset so a stale contracted PricingDate doesn't pin an old pricebook date
expected_behavior: Toggling IsContracted re-routes the line: contracted->catalog clears PricingDate and re-derives from PBE as-of EffectiveDate; catalog->contracted seeds PricingDate; no stale-date carryover
test_setup: Line first priced contracted (PricingDate seeded), detach asset / set IsContracted=false, reprice -> expect catalog price + reset PricingDate

prior_run.actual: Could not smoke-test the source-switch transition. Org-wide query: 0 of all QuoteLineItems and 0 of all OrderItems in FortraUAT have PricingContractId set (engine IsContracted is derived from PricingContractId), so the ContactedPricing branch (IsContracted==true) has NEVER fired on any real record and no contracted->catalog toggle exists to reprice. No known-good contracted positive control to clone. Catalog-side half is healthy: both real control lines (Cobalt Strike QLI 0QLWC000003HRWi4AO Unit/List=20500; 5250 Integrator QLI 0QLWC000003kESr4AM Net=6539.75) have PricingContractId=null and route the non-contracted catalog/derived path.
prior_run.evidence: SOQL: SELECT COUNT(Id) FROM QuoteLineItem WHERE PricingContractId!=null => 0; same on OrderItem => 0 (29408 Activated Contracts exist but none drives line pricing). Procedure live retrieve Data/pricing-v21-validation/live/expressionSetDefinition/Rev_Mgmt_Default_Pricing_Procedure.expressionSetDefinition-meta.xml lines 1508-1589: ContactedPricing filter (IsContracted IsNotNull AND IsContracted=true AND PricingDate IsNull) -> ContactedPricing28 assigns PricingDate=EffectiveDate; lines 3027-3076: unconditional PricingEffectiveDates assigns PricingDate=EffectiveFrom for every line each reprice. Describe: PricingDate and IsContracted are NOT persisted columns on QuoteLineItem/OrderItem (only PricingContractId reference exists), so no stale PricingDate can carry over between reprices.
